name: Do garage conversions affect property taxes?

mainEntity.name: Do garage conversions affect property taxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, assessor re-evaluates after permitting; added habitable square footage increases assessed value, though ADUs under 750 sq ft often get impact fee exemptions.
